newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines arrests another communist leader.
newsitem.headline: Philippines arrests another communist leader.

text.p: The Philippines has captured a top communist leader linked to the bombing of U.S. facilities in Manila, the second senior guerrilla arrested in the capital within a week, the military said on Saturday.

A military statement said the army had arrested Noel Gamalinda, suspected of having led the assassination of Colonel Saturnino Dumlao, a military intelligence officer, and of bombing attacks on the U.S. embassy compound and the U.S. library and culture centre in the 1980s.
Gamalinda was held on Friday afternoon at a railway terminal in suburban Pasay city in Manila, and is being held in military custody. No charges have been filed against him.
On Friday, the Philippine police announced the arrest of Joel Castillo, suspected head of the urban hit squad Alex Boncayao Brigade.
Castillo, who was arrested last weekend, is linked to the killing of several businessmen and a Singaporean boy in Manila.
